description: Drill into a recording for MORE visual detail: get the exact frame at a specific time (at) or when a specific word/phrase was spoken (word). Use when get_annotated_frames did not show what a reference ('this','here','that') means, or to see a moment the transcript mentions. Returns the asset frame at that moment (plus the active shared screen, if any) and a transcript snippet around it.

at.description: recording time in seconds (a visual_references recording_time, or S from a [phrase](#rt=S) link in the content)

element_id.description: The recording feedback item (element) to drill into

source.description: limit to the asset frame or the shared-screen frame

word.description: a word or short phrase the reviewer spoke

name: get_frame
title: Get frame
